newsitem.title: INDIA: India's HCL copper prices for February 1997.
newsitem.headline: India's HCL copper prices for February 1997.

text.p: Following are copper/product prices for February, 1997, announced by the state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd, and circulated by the Bombay Metal Exchange Ltd.
The data is the latest available.

The above prices are exclusive of excise duty, octroi (entry tax) sales tax etc. which will be charged extra as applicable. The prices of Item No. 1, & 2 are for deliveries ex-our godown at Central Warehousing Corporation, Cotton Green, Bombay and for Item No. 3 & 4 Ex-Our Taloja works. However,for C.C.Rods sales ex:
Ex-Bombay Godown Rs 1,26,350 PMT Rs 1,25,350 PMT
Ex-Goa Godown Rs 1,27,000 PMT Rs 1,26,000 PMT
Ex-Indore Godown Rs 1,26,600 PMT Rs 1,25,600 PMT
Ex-Silvasa Godown Rs 1,26,820 PMT Rs 1,25,820 PMT

The excise duty applicable for the above Ex:godown prices for C.C.Rods will be the amount paid by our plant at Taloja at the time of despatch of the particular consignment.SalesTax,Octroi and other statutory levies will be charged extra as applicable.
